learning_outcomes.text: Students get an overview of applications and basic types of robots and know their architectures.
They know the typical components in the field of sensors, actuators, and gears and understand the basic design criteria.
The basic problem of a simple robot kinematics (SCARA robot arm) is understood and can be calculated with a simple model.
Furthermore, the control engineering approaches and the various possibilities for programming industrial robots are known.
Students also know the basic architectures and requirements of mobile robotics and highly automated driving.

syllabus_topics: Basic components of a robot: Sensor technology, Actuator technology, Gears
Direct and inverse kinematics using the example of the SCARA robot
Mobile robotics and highly automated driving
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. Grading is weighted by credit points.
